item.name: Create a comment on a post

request.name: Create a comment on a post

description.content: Creates a new comment on a specific discussion post. Comments can include text, mentions, tags, and attachments.

description.content: Returns a paginated list of top-level comments on a post. Soft-deleted comments are included with isDeleted=true and blanked content so reply trees remain navigable. Authentication is optional — unauthenticated requests omit requesterContext.

description.content: Edits the authenticated user's own comment in-place. Sets editStatus to Edited. Emotion counts, repliesCount, and created are preserved. Owner is derived from the auth token.

description.content: Soft-deletes the authenticated user's own comment. Sets isDeleted=true and blanks message text and attachments. Replies are preserved and the parent post's totalCommentsAndReplies is decremented only by the deleted node.

description.content: Returns a paginated list of replies nested under a specific comment. Authentication is optional.

query.description: Number of items to return (1–100, default 20)

response.name: Paginated reply list

description.content: Creates a reply nested under an existing comment. Replies are 1-level deep — replying to a reply attaches to the same parent comment with an inline @mention to the reply author. Increments parent comment's repliesCount and the post's totalCommentsAndReplies.
